<div class="content-intro"><p>Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.</p> <p>Empowering the world starts with living <a href="https://ouraring.com/about-us">our values</a> and empowering our team. In this role, you will gather and synthesize requirements from internal stakeholders, translate product and system needs into clear silicon requirements, and work closely with semiconductor vendors and technology partners to shape the architecture, roadmap, and execution plan for new custom silicon.</p> <p>This is a highly collaborative role spanning product, engineering, operations, and external silicon partners. This opportunity will be hybrid in San Francisco.</p> <p><strong>What You will do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and communicate custom-silicon architectures for Oura’s future wearable platforms, balancing performance, power, size, schedule, cost, and risk.</li> <li>Gather requirements from product, hardware, firmware, software, algorithms, sensing, and operations teams, and translate them into silicon capabilities, interfaces, performance targets, and power targets</li> <li>Partner with silicon vendors to translate system requirements into silicon requirements, assessing architecture options, and driving execution within product timelines</li> <li>Lead technical discussions and trade-off decisions with vendors across compute, memory, connectivity, security, power, packaging, test, and manufacturing considerations.</li> <li>Work with internal engineering teams and vendors to define validation, characterization, bring-up, and production-readiness plans.</li> <li>Stay current on emerging semiconductor technologies, process capabilities, packaging approaches, and industry trends relevant to wearable health products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We would love to have you on our team,
